calibration_notes: First conditional quadgram objective failed the hidden-key control; failure preserved. Replaced by joint quadgram score using the control only.
Dante input repeated twice; duplicate removed before final Italian control. Final test contains only the first Paradiso, distinct from Inferno/Purgatorio language training.
Multi-letter units are extracted inside words before removing spaces.
Naibbe global-permutation control reduces mathematically to the Latin permutation control once the published morphology is supplied; not an independent third control.
limitations: No new meaning assigned. No broad rejection of ciphers or natural languages.
Classical Latin and Dante do not cover medieval technical language or every dialect.
Quadgram scores are bits per four-letter window, not per-character entropies or translation accuracy.
Best real candidates are exploratory selections across multiple variants; no p-value or statistical decipherment claim.
Initial raw EVA cases drop uncertain tokens and may concatenate across them; extended cases preserve uncertainty as segment breaks.
Labels paragraph_occurrences counts distinct paragraph loci containing the form, not repeated token instances within a line.
Fixed held-out subset used for exploratory comparison; no third independent confirmation set.
